☐ Anthology check

  Currently the vendor-data path requires `attainment_member`-flagged rows to
  also have `attainment_date >= min_anthology_partition`. In dateless mode
  there's no per-row date. Should we still sanity-check anthology coverage at
  all, or just trust that the most recent partition exists?

❯ 1. Skip the partition gate entirely (Recommended)
     Dateless mode means "use whatever anthology partition is most recent." If
     the account has anthology data at all, the partition lookup in
     `build_outcome_dataset_from_anthology` (`MAX(partition_id)`) will find it.
  2. Require at least one anthology partition exists per precision
     Add an explicit assertion before training that `MAX(partition_id)` returns
     a non-null value for each requested precision. Belt-and-suspenders.
  3. Type something.

  4. Chat about this
